description: Cleaned-up fork of exp392. Dropped redundant config keys (per_layer_embedding_dim, pos_emb_dim, qk_input_nap, qk_tph, *_backward_mode, multialt_learnable_temps, uncertainty_T_init, canon_temperature, out_proj_multi_nap, out_tph_per_layer, lut_beta1, lut_beta2, causal) and matching train.py branches. v_lut traded NAP=8 tph=32 -> NAP=6 tph=128 (param-matched, 4x v_lut bandwidth: 192 -> 768 lookups/token per layer). out_proj is plain TinyMHLut(NAP=6, tph=512) instead of single-component multi-nap wrapper (functionally identical). All other settings identical to exp392.
